name: Ring of Tenacious Spells
body:
Price 6,750 gp; Aura moderate abjuration; CL 9; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring is forged in an intricate lattice of copper that covers most of the length of a finger. The ring flexes and bends with the finger without breaking however.

The ring must be worn and attuned to for 24 hours before its effects can benefit the wearer and if it is removed for more than 24 hours, the wearer must re-attune to it before use.

The wearer is considered to be 4 levels higher for the purposes of dispel or counterspell attempts made against spells you cast.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,375 gp; Feats Forge Ring, dispel magic
